A.notes: A competent, straightforward execution of the brief. The CSS illustration of seedlings growing is charming and functional. However, the typography and overall layout feel a bit templated and lack a distinct voice.

B.notes: An exceptional translation of the brief into a unified design. Translating the single provided statistic (140 hectares) into 140 individually animated CSS leaves is a brilliant data visualization choice. The typography is elegant and handles the bilingual requirement beautifully, though it loses some points on accessibility due to the list markup error on the 140 leaves.

raw.why: Site B takes the strict constraints of the brief and turns them into a highly original, visually compelling story with excellent typographic craft.
